column5: Exact NC State Raleigh INSPIRE ultrashort electroporation two cohorts, same Jewels Darrow, exact weight/liver lesions and intervention. AVMA VCT24005833 study end 2027-07-25 does not supersede explicit institutional Enrollment Finish 2027-07-01.

VCT26005971 Fort Worth specifically reports doxorubicin with temozolomide with/without propranolol while its eligibility invokes carboplatin. Distinct from Dallas VCT25005913. No owner-facing treatment change, pending corrected primary regimen.
VCT24005850 recruiting exact Michigan State CMP-002 dose escalation, 5 kg and five same diseases/organ function/washout. October 29 2027 study end used for cutoff; no new trial.

VCT24005858 names Veterinary Oncology Services, New York, James Impellizeri; not newer implant/cementoplasty VCT26005963 and no named current clinical address or permitted primary intake route for this exact bone ECT cohort. Study end 2027-01-01 alone cannot create new matching access.

VCT16000005 exact Virginia Tech Mindy Quigley, MRI-guided intratumoral IL-13PE38QQR cytotoxin infusion, 3–45 kg and same surgery/chemo/immunotherapy washouts. Cutoff June 5 2027 published; not a duplicate new trial.
VCT26005965 exact CSU Fort Collins intratumoral novel lipid TLR nanoparticle protocol, same contact, feasibility/exclusions and local anesthesia procedure. Existing December 31 2027 cutoff confirmed.

Exact UF current oncology master names the SBRT/percutaneous cementoplasty trial Closed Enrollment, while individual old intake language remains. Closed enrollment for that UF joint study, not all ECT/implant trials; no distinct active canonical ID.

Exact Kansas State MT-003 plus radiation leaf is available but no current intake shown on institution active roster or a dated public opening notice. Do not infer closed solely from omission; preserve onward recheck on dated K-State intake.

UQ article names Enzistat and two advanced canine cohorts, but both present organizer trial lists have no currently enrolling Enzistat route, explicit cutoff or funding. No transferable link to the UQ appendicular OSA vaccine. Require present owner eligibility.

Hospital exact archived macroscopic feline mammary carcinoma toceranib protocol correlates with reported ESVONC 2014 results. Undated Abiertos category does not establish a contemporary owner admission or funding. Preserve only as ambiguous historical signal.

Phase II canine tumor study provides its drug but no dated current intake or fresh authority besides undated leaf/index. Preserve local status and allow a current exact dated intake announcement to reopen.
AB07008 exact historical masitinib canine cutaneous mast-cell program with 2015 sponsor update, no dated current enrollment at VOC. Do not confuse approved commercial masitinib with a current study.

Exact Taiwan PT001 cohort and eight official Taiwan centers already present. Sept 11 regulatory permission in Hungary has no active clinic level recruitment/address or costs. Pending official opening, do not add Hungary sites.

Early Zürich DVG flyer names feline injection-site sarcoma, same investigator as another protocol, but no ZH226/2024 inhibitor identity or consent and different timelines/costs. Cannot infer either a second new program or transfer CHF 1,200 pricing to ADAM-12; seek an authoritative exact linkage.

Exact retrieved Frégis page describes legacy Dissectron nonfunded HCC surgery without dated enrollment or patient protocol. Already cataloged embolization and thermal ablation are distinct; this is not established as a current new treatment study.
